items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: A fella by the name of Zeno. He had a ballroom, he had a piano in the ballroom. ... Adam Zeno.

ctx.x: I heard of it. I didn't have a damn business.

That's the way I thought you was to play. Then I had a set of guys, what's his name? He was a piano player. Big 25, didn't he? You know what they call Big 25? Well he had a piano in there. I used to go and answer the piano. I didn't play piano when I was really young. Well that's why Caillou and them used to go there too and play piano. I used to go down at the ballroom at St. Bernard and Cranbourne. A fella by the name of Zeno. He had a ballroom, he had a piano in the ballroom. He had a piano in the ballroom. He…
Was he a piano player? I don't know.
